data_section_full_text:
The initial sample consists of firm-year observations from the intersection of COMPUSTAT and CRSP databases over the period of 1999 to 2009. Our sample period starts in
1999 because one of the indicators of political ties (i.e., lobbying efforts) only became
available since the second half of 1998. We then delete observations with missing COMPUSTAT data needed to calculate our tax aggressiveness variables and control variables.
We also exclude firm-year observations with negative book values and observations with
total assets of less than $1 million. Firms from the financial services and utilities industries
are also excluded. After merging the tax and control variables with our political connections database, we are left with a final sample of 32,898 firm-year observations.
